prompt_markdown: The intake desk needs a new ticket script, and you are working with an AI tool.
Which of these must stay with you?

options.text: Looking up how to format text with an f-string.
Writing the first draft of a print statement.
Deciding which personal details the ticket may show.
Suggesting a name for a variable.

why: What personal data may be shown is a privacy decision. You are accountable for it, so it cannot be delegated.
